skill_name: Explain why the global population is still growing despite the threat of overpopulation.
workflow: Despite the threat of overpopulation, the global population continues to grow due to a variety of factors. Many countries have reduced infant and child mortality rates, leading to a longer average lifespan and more births. Developing countries also have a younger population, which means that more people are in the child-bearing age bracket.
